purpose: Complete required CK0 and first25C per-cell derivative-template diagnostics; no proxy scoring, no change to registered beta model
main_step: maximum positive dV/dQ over 50<q<80 Ah, as existing A4
high_SOC: maximum dV/dQ for q>=step+5 and q<=Q_CC-2; feature present only if its derivative >=2 times median derivative in that search window
low_tail_onset: first q in [3,20] with slope <=25% of maximum slope in [0,5] for all next 1 Ah grid points; otherwise unavailable
robust: feature present at all three smoothing widths and span <=1 Ah
selection: diagnostic only; no model selection or retuning
timing: Supplement registered after main A evaluation to fill missing templates, before its own feature evaluation; main pre-registration remains unchanged.
